{{Quote|I am Tre Nareves, goodwill ambassador to Tatooine for the Galactic Republic.|Tre Nareves|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tre Nareves''' was a male [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]], who acted as a goodwill [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. As part of a goodwill initiative to gain support for the Republic, he offered a set of [[X-87 model]] perimeter sensors to the settlers at the [[Chuaro Farmstead]] in the [[Dreviad Wastes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tre Naveres is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Kiff VandenHeuvel]].<ref name="TOR" />
